contract.failure: {ok:false,code,path}; expected input errors do not throw; no raw document, secret or stack fields
contract.strictEnvelope: Exact own root keys schemaVersion/projectSeq/activeProjectId/projectOrder/projects; version 7; safe integer projectSeq in [2,MAX_SAFE_INTEGER], greater than every member ID number. ProjectId is p followed by a positive decimal integer without leading zero, at most MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Nonempty unique projectOrder; projects own keys exactly match it. Each project has exactly name/enabled/props/workspace. Name is already trimmed, 1..32 Unicode code points, unique by NFKC then locale-independent toLowerCase. enabled is boolean. props has exactly connectionRef/dataEnabled/automationEnabled, connectionRef matches [a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}, flags are boolean. workspace is non-null non-array object, schemaVersion 6. At least one enabled project; active ID exists and is enabled. No normalization or default insertion; unknown workspace content retained if callback accepts; duplicate source object keys use last JSON.parse value.
contract.callback: After ALL structural checks, visit projectOrder. Invoke validateWorkspace(JSON deep clone of workspace, projectId) once per visited project; stop at first result other than strict true or synchronous throw. Promise is rejected synchronously without awaiting. Callback mutations cannot reach returned parsedRoot. Fresh parsed objects on each call. Callback external side effects are outside module guarantee.
errorPriority: INVALID_JSON / empty path for parse or any nonfinite number
Per project in projectOrder, complete shape then name then enabled then props then connectionRef then dataEnabled then automationEnabled then workspace before next project
